question: Can a query-blind distribution-learned six-step role grammar guide native public memory retention to rescue cases F60 misses, without sacrificing F60's four-step competence?

method.train: Use only q['ops'] from disjoint F76 negative TRAIN cases with exactly six steps. Count 6-code directed role strings, retain up to top 3 by count descending then code lexicographic ascending. Do not use TRAIN answers or future observations for model fit.
method.online: Only previous retained native records, current public edge, arrival index and frozen grammar; no source seed, family, query, answer or future observations. Take exact native F60 step and F62.actions from SAME prior state. After index>=36 and while one-action latch unused, choose a native alternative if it retains at least min(10,len(F60_baseline)-1) identical records and yields STRICTLY MORE distinct (grammar,start,end) exact directed six-step relational paths than baseline. Rank by added matches, baseline overlap, native enumeration order; otherwise F60.
method.grammar_scoring: Compose entire legal forward and mirrored native records at exact matching endpoints with role-code concatenation. Directed role string must match one frozen learned six-code pattern exactly; no record truncation, no guessed relationships, no query or answer. Dynamic search limited to 512 nodes/prefix-state per candidate; any bound overrun means no intervention.
method.memory: At most twelve native 12B records (144B) plus explicitly separate <=18 grammar bytes and one latch bit; F85 global solver unchanged.
method.training_is_not_prospective: These synthetic role-distribution labels are learned only on TRAIN. Synthetic validation and guard are held out from model derivation and first used after grammar policy is frozen.
method.evidence: F60, F83, F90, F91, F92 source-native controls with identical F85 reasoner; independently audit all 72 public prefixes, 144-byte memory, all question answers uniquely provable from full public graph.
method.positive: At least one F60-failed six-step case rescued, and no F60-correct regressions in any regime or task type, all source/provenance and audit gates valid.
method.negative: Zero six-step rescue or any F60 regression, including inactive mechanisms even if code/CI green.
method.freeze: Do not reselect grammar or adjust thresholds after validation/guard; never use prior exposed negative cases as first-use.

cohorts.source: Frozen F76 two-arrival negative-seed public-only generator; no registered FIT/DIAG/original/F3

order: Run unit tests and train only
Commit immutable trained grammar before either holdout
First validation then one new disjoint guard, without tuning
Preserve negative or positive synthetic evidence without independent scientific promotion
